Exact-rational direct-graph tests enumerate every set for m<=5 at 202 parameter points, supporting rather than replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-set generating polynomial for a natural family of cycle-bearing, central-hub graphs closes a gap in a newly proposed source-placement invariant. Two sharp secondary thresholds change the multiplicity and hub participation of optimal placements without changing the minimum size, providing structural insight beyond a straightforward minimum cardinality. The method is reproducible and covers all m and all real admissible parameters.
